Figure3: The Example Case of MOBA. Please note that several unimportant stages during the execution of a subtask are omitted for clarity. The key features for each part are as follows. Task: MOBA supports cross-application tasks and can interpret indirect commands. Sub-task 1: Memories are retrieved to select target applications and updated to track the trace. Sub-task 3: MOBA will reflect and try other approaches if the attempt is failed. Sub-task 9 and sub-task 13: Memories are used to choose correct actions.
